title: Fire-resistance rated rooms and spaces.
officialText:
Rooms and spaces containing high pressure natural
gas piping shall be separated from all other areas of the building by fire barriers or horizontal
assemblies, or both, having a fire-resistance rating of not less than 3 hours.
